member.summary: Compiles using explicit occurrence and instruction limits, without recursive traversal.
member.remarks: Shared expression objects are expanded per occurrence. Both limits include constants and predicates. Limits must be positive. Exceeding either limit throws before evaluation can begin.

member.name: T:Bezoro.Conditions.ConditionProgram
member.summary: An immutable, bounded Boolean program with short-circuit control flow.
member.remarks: Evaluation reads only this program. Each concurrent evaluation owns its scratch and evaluator state. Single predicates and constants need no scratch; composite expressions use the exact compiled stack bound. Evaluation is atomic with respect to the caller's scheduling budget and never caches predicate results.
